implementation.requestCancellation: cancel_service_request locks the service request first, rejects the exact active booking statuses used by accept_proposal before any writes, and continues to cancel eligible open/closed requests and reject sent proposals when no active booking exists.
implementation.bookingReadback: Request detail uses the current booking ID/status/hold from the existing T05 proposal view state. Closed requests with an active hold route to Continue/Manage booking; historical cancelled/expired bookings do not suppress request cancellation.
implementation.existingBookingSafety: The existing cancel_booking path is unchanged and remains available while the proposal acquisition switch is OFF; no alternate request refund path or new feature flag was added.
implementation.concurrency: A private PostgreSQL integration test uses three distinct backend PIDs and a service-request row-lock barrier to overlap accept_proposal and cancel_service_request, assert both wait on the request lock, and verify the accepted hold cannot coexist with a cancelled request.
